items.headline: FDA approves first engineered virus therapy for treatment-resistant advanced melanoma
items.summary: Regulators approved a genetically modified virus that infects and destroys skin cancer tumor cells, given together with an existing immunotherapy drug for patients whose melanoma kept growing after standard treatment. The approval was based on a trial of one hundred forty patients with advanced, inoperable disease and came with breakthrough therapy and priority review status.
items.why_it_matters: It gives patients with treatment-resistant melanoma a new option once they have run out of standard therapies.
